clues: This town stands on a river in Turkey. The river is the longest in the whole land.
Summers in this town are very hot and dry. Winters in this town are cold and snowy.
Its pot craft here is very old. It most likely dates right back to Hittite times.
Guests come to see the old town. Its sweet streets sit right by the river.
Its pots are made with red river clay. That clay comes from red silt in the river.
